pages.raw_meta: Led by physicians and trusted by patients, Pediatrix delivers advanced medical solutions across a variety of practice areas around the country.
raw_blocks: Specialized Care for Women, Babies and Children
Led by physicians. Trusted by patients. We deliver advanced medical solutions nationwide, in-person and virtually.
Be part of a nationwide team of physicians, advanced practitioners, and operational experts all working to support families and advance patient care.
We are one of the nation's largest providers of prenatal, neonatal and pediatric services.
We operate in 37 states , partner with nearly 400 hospitals , and work with 4,300+ affiliated clinicians .
We bring more than 45 years of experience to help hospitals respond to shifting demands with flexible, patient-centered care strategies .
We invest in clinical services, operations, technology, and education—giving our clinicians the tools, resources, and support they need to deliver exceptional patient care.
Our Center for Research, Education, Quality and Safety is dedicated to advancing care through evidence-based medicine.
Access accredited continuing education—available both live and on demand.
Founded and led by physicians, we understand the importance of a supportive environment. Find your place with us.
Hear from leading experts in neonatology as they explore the latest advances and critical issues in the field.

Highly specialized care for newborn babies

pages.raw_meta: Led by physicians and trusted by patients, Pediatrix offers extensive services that work together across the women’s, babies’ and children’s continuum of care.
raw_blocks: We provide world-class clinical expertise with compassion and a patient-first approach.

Since starting as a single neonatology practice in 1979, we have grown into a multi-specialty group spanning neonatology, maternal-fetal medicine, OB hospitalist medicine, and pediatric specialty care, delivering a continuum of care in the hospital, in our practices and virtually. Through communication and collaboration, our dedicated clinicians put patients first, partnering with expectant moms and new families to build healthy and happy futures.
We deliver intuitive, customized solutions to meet your facility’s needs.
Specialized care for complex and high-risk situations, including prematurity, serious illness, injury, and congenital abnormalities
Our specialists deliver the highest level of care when you need it most
We provide families a team that works together to ensure the best outcomes for mothers and babies
Safe, efficient, high-quality care is at your fingertips with our robust telehealth programs
